By Bianca Sanchez On June 30, 2026

#### Shopping for a new mattress can feel overwhelming. With so many options available, it’s easy to focus only on how a mattress feels in a showroom—but knowing what to look for when buying a mattress goes beyond initial comfort.


#### From long-term protection to flexibility and support after purchase, here are the key factors to consider when choosing the right mattress for your needs.
